title: PSKReporter Band Opening Duration
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pskreporter:spot
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(open_minutes) as open_minutes by _time band
| sort - _time
description: Tracks PSKReporter band opening minutes over time and breaks it out by band.
value: Daily opening duration helps show which bands are actually usable instead of merely noisy.
implementation: Send PSKReporter band opening minutes events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of PSKReporter band opening minutes by band.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how PSKReporter band opening minutes changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
